profiles.description: AI models and datasets: a model's or dataset's registry records as each source stated them - Hugging Face Hub revisions, OpenML dataset versions, tasks and run evaluations, Epoch AI notable-model rows - side by side as of a date, with revisions, declared licences as stated and who reported each figure, never merged or ranked

workflow_defaults.as_of: each source's revision current at the requested date, cited by Hub sha, OpenML id and version, or Epoch vintage
workflow_defaults.sources: Hub, OpenML and Epoch side by side; self-reported card results, OpenML evaluations and Epoch estimates stay with who reported them
workflow_defaults.licences: quoted as declared; SPDX only on an exact licence-id match; no compliance interpretation
workflow_defaults.identity: records of different sources are put side by side only through accepted identity matches on stated identifiers; unmatched records stay visible
workflow_defaults.links: papers, dataset DOIs and registry packages only where a source states the identifier; absent providers reported as provider_absent

vocabulary.revision: one source-stated state of a record: a Hub sha, an OpenML dataset revision or an Epoch row revision
vocabulary.sha: the git commit of a Hub repository revision; a pinned sha is immutable
vocabulary.vintage: one Epoch file release, identified by its content digest
vocabulary.self-reported result: a model-index result stated in a Hub card by the repository itself
vocabulary.not-returned: an OpenML run evaluation a later complete listing no longer names
vocabulary.withdrawn: a repository the source states gated or disabled, or a dataset it states deactivated
